name: Locate Darkness
description: You know the direction of the closest undead or dark creature if any exist within 20 units.

name: Ward the Dead
description: You target an undead creature within 8 units and shoot a beam of energy at them, dealing divine damage.
chargeeffect: Change spell type to 1 unit wide line

name: Tend the Wounded
description: You touch a creature in lifeline and restore 1 lifeline point. If this amount brings the creature to maximum lifeline, they regain 1 health and lose one tier of the wounded condition.
chargeeffect: Change spell range to 6 units

name: Defile Life
description: You abuse your knowledge of the forces of life and nature and touch a humanoid, beast or plantoid, dealing dark damage.
chargeeffect: Add +2 spell attack

name: Cleanse
description: You target an area within a 1 unit radius and perform a ritual, cleansing any objects of poison or disease within that space. This spell also converts any water within the area into holy water.

name: Invisibility Versus Undead
description: You touch a creature and they become invisible to undead who are lower level than your spell damage bonus modifier for as long as you focus on this spell

name: Holy Shield
description: Target a creature within 8 units and grant them additional dark and physical mitigation equal to your spell damage bonus modifier while you focus on this spell.

name: Blessed Flame
description: You enhance a light source you have equipped, extending the range of the light by 2 units while you focus on this spell. While enchanced, the light source does not consume fuel and reveals the presence of any invisible dark or undead creatures that are within the light.

name: Favor
description: You request protection from an entity to offer you guidance when you need it most. For the next hour, the next time you roll a 1 on an attack or defense check, reroll that dice.

name: Minor Healing
description: You touch a creature and restore some of their health.
chargeeffect: Remove any bleeding condition from the target

name: Smite
description: You choose a weapon that you have equipped and bless it with divine power. For the next minute, your attacks with this weapon deal additional divine damage to dark and undead creatures. The dice for the spell damage are doubled on a true hit.
chargeeffect: The extra damage applies to all creatures but the dice are not doubled on a true hit

name: Prayer
description: You spend an hour and dedicate a ritual to an entity in an attempt to gain their favor. Roll a 1d12. On a 7 or higher, gain one luck dice. On a 12, gain a heroic action instead.

name: Blessing
description: You touch a creature, increasing their true hit threshold by 1 while you focus on this spell.
chargeeffect: The spell also affects you

name: Cure Poison
description: You touch one creature and remove any poisoned condition affecting them.

name: Divine Protection
description: You are surrounded in a divine aura, gaining +10 mitigation to all damage types. You cannot take actions or reactions until the start of your next turn.

name: Sacred Fire
description: You unleash divine fire in a 3 unit radius around you dealing fire damage to anyone within the area. Any undead or dark creature that is affected by this spell gains the ignited condition.
chargeeffect: The ignite deals divine damage instead of fire

name: Holy Messenger
description: You create an ethereal dove and launch it at a target within 10 units dealing divine damage when it explodes on impact.
chargeeffect: Increase range by 10 units and damage dice becomes 3d6

name: Vindication
description: In response to a creature within 6 units being the target of a true hit, you say a short prayer. For the next minute, the next time that creature restores health, they gain the maximum dice value instead of needing to roll.

name: Lesser Healing
description: You touch a creature and restore some of their health. If your target is diseased, it removes the condition but the heal is reduced by half.
chargeeffect: Removes any bleeding, blinded or deafened condition from the target that is not from a permanent cause

name: Sanctuary
description: You create a divine santuary with a radius of 4 units that lasts as long as you focus on this spell. Any dark or undead creature under the level of your spell damage bonus modifier cannot willfully enter the sanctuary. If a dark or undead creature enters the sanctuary against their will, they take damage at the start of their turn.
chargeeffect: The radius of the spell is increased by 1

name: Halo
description: You target a creature within 10 units and summon a halo on top of their head. While you focus on this spell, the creature takes divine damage at the end of their turn if they have made an attack against an allied creature.
chargeeffect: If the target is an undead or dark creature, add 1d6 spell attack

name: Defense Against Darkness
description: In response to making a dodge, block or resistance check against an undead or dark creature, add an additional 1d4 to that check and any subsequent checks against those types until the start of your next turn.

name: Spirit Mend
description: You touch one creature and remove any diseased, wounded or paralyzed condition affecting them, even if they are caused by permanent conditions.

name: Choir of Faith
description: You target a point within 14 units and summon a pillar of divine light emitting a booming chorus. Any creature within a 3 unit radius takes divine damage and is deafened until the end of their next turn.
chargeeffect: Instead of deafened, undead and dark creatures become maddened until the end of their next turn

name: Repentance
description: You shoot a ray of energy at a target within 16 units dealing divine damage. If the creature is humanoid or divine, it immediately uses its reaction to make an attack on an adjacent creature, prioritizing enemies before allied creatures.
chargeeffect: Target an additional creature

name: Divine Strike
description: Your next weapon attack deals divine damage instead of the usual primary damage and targets everyone within a 2 unit cone. On a true hit, the attack becomes a brutal critical against dark and undead creatures.

name: Chasten
description: You call down judgement upon a creature within 14 units and remove the maddened, confused and charmed condition from them. For each condition removed, the creature takes 1d10 divine damage. If this spell is channeled under an open sky, the spell deals 1d12 lightning damage for each condition instead.
chargeeffect: The spell does not remove conditions but deals the damage as if 3 conditions were removed.

name: Divine Weapon
description: You touch a normal weapon, turning it into a divine weapon, causing it to become imbued with divine magic. This weapon gives off light within a 3 unit area and deals an extra 1d8 divine damage. This weapon lasts for 1 day.
components: A Weapon, which disintegrates when the Spell ends

name: Celestial Healing
description: You touch a creature and restore some of their health. At the start of that creatures next 3 turns, they heal for an additional amount equal to your spell damage bonus modifier. While this spell is affecting a creature, they are immune to the bleeding and poison condition.

name: Beam of Radiance
description: You fire a line of divine light 20 units long and 3 units wide, dealing divine damage to anyone within. This spell deals an additional 2d10 damage to undead and dark creatures who fail their check.
chargeeffect: Splash damage affects all creature types

name: Seek Darkness
description: You speak the name of, or specify the type of, an undead or dark creature you have previously encountered. You will immediately know if that creature is within 100 units and in which direction it is located, or the direction of the closest creature of that type.

name: Banish the Darkness
description: You target a dark or undead creature from another plane within 10 units and attempt to untether it from the current plane you are on. While you focus on this spell, the creature must make a resistance check against your initial spell attack at the start of each turn. If the creature reaches 4 failures, it vanishes and is returned to its home plane.
chargeeffect: Add +2 spell attack
components: an Icon made of Gold and Gems worth at 100GP

name: Create Shrine
description: You perform a ritual to designate a 2 by 2 unit area for a permanent shrine. While this shrine has at least 500gp worth of offerings within the area, whenever you take a full rest, you get credit for a favorable rest and any conditions on you are removed if you are on the same plane as the shrine.
components: Bundle of Incense and a Pinch of Powdered Electrum

name: Mass Healing
description: You heal up to 3 creatures within 3 units of you.
chargeeffect: Add 3 creatures and range becomes 6 units

name: Judgement
description: You target a creature within 14 units and surround them in a radiant aura, dealing divine damage. Additionally, roll a 1d4. The affected creature suffers a penalty on all attack rolls equal to that amount until the end of of their next turn.
chargeeffect: If the creature is dark or undead, the 1d4 becomes a 4.

name: Valor
description: In response to a humanoid within 8 units dropping to 0 health from taking damage but before they roll a lifeline check, you infuse them with divine valor. The target then makes their lifeline check with a +2 bonus. Until the affected creature reaches 7 lifeline points, their melee attacks deal divine damage instead of the primary type. True hits with melee weapons become brutal criticals and deal lightning damage as their primary type.
chargeeffect: If the creature is dark or undead, the 1d4 becomes a 4.

name: Divine Healing
description: You target a creature within 12 units and restore some of their health as well as curing any paralyzed, deafened, blinded, maddened, poisoned, bleeding or diseased conditions on them. If the creature is brought to full health by this spell, any missing body parts are also restored.

name: Resurrection
description: You perform a ritual and resurrect a dead creature that has died within the last decade from any cause that wasn't natural. A character who is resurrected in this way regains consciousness after their next favorable full rest.
components: A Diamond and a piece of the dead Creature.

name: Destroy Darkness
description: You touch a dark or undead creature and pour divine power in an effort to unmake them. If the creature is of a lower level than your spell damage bonus modifier, it is destroyed.
chargeeffect: Add 1d6 to the level threshold

name: Hallowed Ground
description: You target an area such as a dwelling that fits within a 20 unit cube and perform a ritual to make the ground sacred by installing an idol. While sacred, no dark or undead creature can willfully enter the grounds. Any dark or undead creature that starts their turn within the grounds takes 2d12 divine damage. Any full rest taken within these grounds is automatically considered favorable. This spell ends if the idol is destroyed or removed from area.

name: Armageddon
description: You cause the sky to burn and turn red. While you focus on this spell, you can use 1 action and 4 power to bring down a meteor with a spell attack at a point within 100 units, dealing fire damage in a 2 unit radius.

name: Celestial Weapon
description: You turn a mutable weapon into a celestial weapon, causing it to become imbued with divine magic, converting the physical damage to divine damage. This weapon gives off light within a 6 unit radius, which can be activated and deactivated with a free action. True hits with this weapon are considered brutal criticals.

name: Commune
description: You perform a ritual, placing yourself into a dream-like state and requesting an audience with an entity on another plane or demi-plane which the entity is not obligated to accept. This audience can last up to 1 hour, but only 1 minute passes while you are in this state.

name: Wrath of the Gods
description: You call 3 rays of light from the heavens, each one counting as a seperate attack at the same target within 30 units. Each attack that hits grants an additional damage dice on the next ray.
chargeeffect: Damage dice become 1d12

name: Healing Sphere
description: You create a sphere of radiant energy with a radius of 3 units at a location you can see within 20 units that lasts until the end of your next turn. Any creature that ends their turn inside the sphere is healed. If you use another action to channel this spell again while the sphere is still active, the spell consumes power but does not require components.
chargeeffect: The radius of the spell is increased by 2
